title: BifrostCore data model
description: Type-contract registry, not a persistence schema — core/ has no database (survey found zero DDL/ORM/migration evidence). Shapes here mirror core/schemas/*.go Go structs and are cited path:line in data-master-erd.md. erd_master.puml draws these entities.

ChannelMessage.description: Pooled per-request unit that travels through a provider's queue/worker channel. Owned by: F-001 Core Engine. Introduced by: F-001. [D: core/bifrost.go:62]

handoff.description: CAS-guarded enum: open/claimed/abandoned, exactly one winner [D: core/bifrost.go:76,79-83]

sentAt.description: zero value = unset; stamped by worker immediately before sending [D: core/bifrost.go:69]

Fallback.description: A named next-provider/model pair a request retries against on failure. Owned by: F-001. Introduced by: F-001. [D: core/schemas/bifrost.go:553]

BifrostContext.description: Custom mutable context.Context carrying request-scoped keys (governance, retry, trace/span, virtual key). Owned by: F-002. Introduced by: F-002. [D: core/schemas/context.go:77]

NetworkConfig.description: Per-provider network client configuration. Owned by: F-002. Introduced by: F-002. [D: core/schemas/provider.go:60]

ProviderConfig.description: Per-provider configuration wrapper. Owned by: F-002. Introduced by: F-002. [D: core/schemas/provider.go:556]

PluginConfig.description: Plugin registration/config shape. Owned by: F-002. Introduced by: F-002. [D: core/schemas/plugin.go:401]

BifrostRequest.description: Top-level request envelope covering all 30+ operation types. Owned by: F-002 (shape) / F-001 (routes it). Introduced by: F-002. [D: core/schemas/bifrost.go:571]

BifrostResponse.description: Top-level response envelope. Owned by: F-002. Introduced by: F-002. [D: core/schemas/bifrost.go:1125]

BifrostStreamChunk.description: One chunk of a streamed response. Owned by: F-002. Introduced by: F-002. [D: core/schemas/bifrost.go:1913]

BifrostError.description: Normalized error envelope with provider/model/request-type metadata. Owned by: F-002. Introduced by: F-002. [D: core/schemas/bifrost.go:1954]

Error.description: nested error detail, e.g. Message [D: core/schemas/bifrost.go:1954-1963]

BifrostChatRequest.description: Chat completion request shape. Owned by: F-002 (canonical shape) / converted per-provider in F-003. Introduced by: F-002. [D: core/schemas/chatcompletions.go:14]

BifrostChatResponse.description: Chat completion response shape. Owned by: F-002. Introduced by: F-002. [D: core/schemas/chatcompletions.go:36]

Key.description: Provider API key record: identity, weighting, per-provider key config, enablement. Owned by: F-002. Introduced by: F-002. [D: core/schemas/account.go:135-160]

ChatMessage.description: A single message in a chat conversation. Owned by: F-002. Introduced by: F-002. [D: core/schemas/chatcompletions.go:1100]

ChatTool.description: A tool/function definition exposed to the model, including MCP tool annotations. Owned by: F-002 (shape) / F-004 (MCP-sourced tools). Introduced by: F-002. [D: core/schemas/chatcompletions.go:418]

BifrostLLMUsage.description: Token usage accounting, including reasoning-token breakdown. Owned by: F-002. Introduced by: F-002. [D: core/schemas/chatcompletions.go:1925]

BifrostCost.description: Cost accounting for a request. Owned by: F-002. Introduced by: F-002. [D: core/schemas/chatcompletions.go:2050]

MCPClientEntry.description: An MCP client's connection-state record. Owned by: F-004. Introduced by: F-004. [D: core/mcp/clientmanager.go:2090]. CONTRADICTION FLAGGED: the code comment at this line names states 'Disconnected'/'Connected', but the real MCPConnectionState enum values are healthy/unstable/error/pending_verification/disabled/needs_reauth/degraded — see ddd/domain_DOM-001-mcp-integration.md Open questions. Do not treat 'Disconnected'/'Connected' as real values.
